description: Manchester Airport Safeguarding Zone - wind turbines is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Salford City Council. Dataset showing that the city council should consult with Manchester Airport for any wind turbine development within the city boundary. The purpose of the safeguarding zone is to ensure that the operational integrity or safety of the airport may be assured. Coverage: Salford City Council. The portal files it under the publisher Salford City Council. It offers 2 resource(s) in WMS. The portal shows 2016-07-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
